text: Neil Ericsson was a Swedish immigrant who had fought in the Geronimo campaigns as a cavalry sergeant,
and who would later become the very first ranger of the Chiricahua National Forest.
Emma Peterson, also from Sweden, had worked as a maid for an army colonel.
They met at Fort Bowie, married in 1887, and claimed a homestead in Benita Canyon.
Neil later wrote that Emma had found the place and thought it was the most gorgeous spot she had ever seen.
